The Far East is lost in August 1918 (new event, counterpart nobody), the FER page makes the FER a buffer state at Verkhneudinsk, and the FER dossier has no event with the RSFSR before the 15 November 1922 merger; the 1920-1922 keyframe excludes the FER land. Reason and pages in the notes file.
Reviewer date not confirmed: Karakalpakstan 1930 is on none of the pages read; the RSFSR keyframe starts it in 1925 (Karakalpak AO, an autonomous area within the RSFSR) at confidence 1.

Changes beyond the findings: south-russia Kharkov moved from May to 25 June 1919 (Ukrainian War of Independence page; the Southern Front page dates only the offensive); Belgorod and the Rostov-Volgograd remainder now name the RSFSR instead of the Ukrainian SSR; Tsaritsyn is confidence 3 (Wrangel page dates June 1919); Northern Taurida's counterpart is the Ukrainian SSR because the land lies inside that republic's shape; RSFSR Brest-Litovsk region drops Poland; the Pepelyayev event uses the 1921 Yakut revolt page.

Page budget exceeded again (south-russia 7 pages, Ukrainian SSR 13, RSFSR 33): the Civil War, the 1920 Polish front, the Belarus and Karakalpak transfers and the German occupation each needed their own pages.

For the orchestrator, internal-unit convention: empire-of-japan records its 1945 Sakhalin and Kuril losses to union-of-soviet-socialist-republics while the RSFSR dossier gains them (counterpart empire-of-japan); the RSFSR Kaliningrad gain now names union-of-soviet-socialist-republics; tuvan-people-s-republic dissolves to the USSR while the RSFSR gains Tuva.
